# T-2: Integrate flow commands

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Enable automatic runtime logging for prepare, resume, get, set, run, and report show, and persist step runtimeLog metadata only where a workflow step owns the command.

## Acceptance Criteria
- flow prepare, get, set, run, resume, and report show append runtime log blocks.
- Step-associated commands update the correct step runtimeLog metadata.
- Non-step commands do not add runtimeLog metadata to flow.json.
- flow report show failures return or throw through dispatcher handling instead of calling process.exit.

## Implementation Notes
Change src/flow.js dispatch policy and use registry or flow manager helpers to map step-associated commands to target steps. Exclude finalize-cleanup from step metadata because its command body owns final flow.json commit and cleanup.

## Test Strategy
Unit and e2e tests for representative commands: prepare, get status, set note, run review or gate, and report show.
